1.
This is an incomplete case which is pending before this Court since October 2024, and has been listed before this Court by the registry for passing appropriate orders.
In fact, there is a general direction for listing all those cases, which have neither been pursued, nor the requisite corrections and the defects as pointed out by the registry, have been removed.

2. Considering the fact that the main appeal was filed for assailing the judgment passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge, Karnal, whereby, accused/respondent has been acquitted under Sections 323, 376(2)(n) and 506 of IPC, and further noticing that no one has appeared to remove the objections/deficiencies pointed out by the Registry, the present petition is liable to be disposed of in accordance with law.
3. Thus, the present petition is hereby dismissed, same being neither valid nor prosecuted.
